name: Large control-style mouse pad
summary: Your mouse surface affects how predictable stopping and starting feels. A large, consistent cloth pad is a low-cost upgrade that also gives you room for low sensitivity settings.
lookFor: Surface texture: control surfaces stop more easily, speed surfaces glide further
Size large enough to swipe at your chosen sensitivity without running out of room
A non-slip rubber base and stitched edges that will not fray
A flat surface that is the same across the whole pad
suitableFor: Anyone using a lower sensitivity, or anyone whose current surface is a desk, a worn pad or something uneven.
pros: Inexpensive compared with most other gear
